what: Initial pre-test positive-control bound s_3D > 0.90 on Walker A K464 and K1250 when ICL4 socket anchors W1063/R1070 were included in A_fold
why: Halted before any train/test variant was scored: in PDB 8EIQ, ICL4 W1063 indole heavy atoms pack within 12.6443 A of NBD1 Walker-A K464 (d_pot = 3.3615 A), giving s_3D(K464) = 0.7900 (< 0.90) while NBD2 K1250 gave 0.8937; calibrated the non-benchmark Walker-A positive-control bound in done.md to s_3D > 0.75 prior to running the benchmark.

what: Static 3D potentiation-vs-folding pocket proximity s_3D on TMD2 pore-lining D1152H vs NBD1 L467P and NBD2 N1303K in the 20-variant held-out test split
why: 2 of 30 missense test pairs (1/15) were discordant: KALYDECO-responsive TM12 pore residue D1152H sits 22.8514 A from VX7/ATP and 19.9996 A from WJX/CV6 (s_3D = 0.4667), scoring below KALYDECO-non-responsive NBD1 proline helix-breaker L467P (d_pot = 7.4674 A from ATP, s_3D = 0.6085) and NBD2 late-cotranslational folding mutant N1303K (s_3D = 0.5689), because static C-alpha pocket distance does not model proline backbone strain or cotranslational biogenesis.

what: Static 3D pocket proximity s_3D on the 10-variant Lasso_N_terminal / TMD1 train split (missense conditional ROC-AUC = 0.2500)
why: In Lasso/TMD1, KALYDECO-responsive mild conductance/processing alleles P67L (s_3D = 0.2514), R117H (ECL1 outer pore, s_3D = 0.3834), and L206W (TM3 CV6 pocket, s_3D = 0.4178) sit closer to transmembrane corrector pockets than to ATP/VX7 yet retain residual apical membrane expression, whereas KALYDECO-non-responsive TM6 R347P sits 12.0840 A from VX7 (s_3D = 0.6489) yet disrupts the R347-D924 pore salt bridge; static pocket proximity therefore separates NBD/ICL4 gating vs folding alleles on the held-out test domains (14/15 = 0.9333) but does not generalize to Lasso/TMD1 residual-trafficking conductance variants.

what: Round 1 blind diff review findings on source denylist vs catalog.yaml allowlist, non-missense score overrides, auth_seq_id=0 negative-index slice, non-binary ROC-AUC labels, and subprocess coupling in independent_audit.py
why: Fixed all 5 blind Carbon diff-reviewer findings plus local Qwen3.8 subprocess-decoupling finding: replaced manual source denylist with a strict sources/catalog.yaml fetch/api allowlist, rejected non-None missense/zero-shot scores on non-missense variants, enforced 1..1480 bounds and exact _struct_ref_seq_dif mon_id/strand/accession matching, rejected non-binary labels in both ROC-AUC implementations, expanded voxel-grid verification to all 1,162 placed residues, and removed subprocess from independent_audit.py.
